traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), families 33 Hydrangeaceae, 43 Cornaceae, 46 Nyssaceae and 105 Loasaceae, which make APG's Cornales: leaves without stipules; the calyx tube adnate to an inferior ovary.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Cornales page (read 2026-10-16): opposite in Cornus, Grubbiaceae and the Hydrangeaceae+Loasaceae clade; spiral in Alangium, Nyssaceae, Hydrostachyaceae. Weighting ours.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Cornales page (read 2026-10-16): opposite pairs in most; spiral in Nyssaceae, Alangium, Hydrostachyaceae.

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Cornales page (read 2026-10-16): simple leaves typical; Hydrostachyaceae deeply divided; some Loasaceae pinnatisect.

traits.division_pattern.note: APweb, Cornales page (read 2026-10-16): lobed blades in Hydrangeaceae+Loasaceae; Loasaceae pinnately cut (family value).

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Cornales page (read 2026-10-16): trees, shrubs and herbs; rosettes only in aquatic Hydrostachyaceae (override).

traits.leaf_habit.note: APweb, Cornales page (read 2026-10-16): Cornaceae mostly deciduous; Curtisiaceae and Grubbiaceae evergreen; Hydrangeaceae both. Weighting ours.

traits.inflorescence.note: APweb, Cornales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): inflorescence cymose.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Cornales page (read 2026-10-16): Curtisiaceae inflorescences terminal; Cornus and Hydrangea cymes end shoots (ours). Nyssa axillary.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb, Cornales page (read 2026-10-16): flowers regular with valvate free petals throughout; sterile showy marginal flowers of some Hydrangea are the main exception.

traits.corolla_shape.note: APweb, Cornales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): petals valvate, apparently free, spreading (rotate is our reading).

traits.carpels.note: APweb, Cornales page (read 2026-10-16): Hydrostachyaceae and Grubbiaceae 2, Curtisiaceae 2-4; Hydrangeaceae and Loasaceae mostly 3-5 (family values). Weighting ours.

traits.fruit_type.note: APweb, Cornales page (read 2026-10-16): drupes in Cornaceae, Nyssaceae, Curtisiaceae; Hydrangeaceae and Loasaceae (the most species) capsular (family values).

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Cornales page (read 2026-10-16): Nyssaceae dioecious, andromonoecious or perfect; Hydrostachyaceae dioecious; others perfect.
